question.worked_solution:
For compatible matrices $A,$ $B,$ and $C,$ and scalar $\alpha ,$ the Hadamard product has the following properties:

- Commutativity:

$$
A⊙B=B⊙A
$$

- Associativity:

$$
(A⊙B)⊙C=A⊙(B⊙C)
$$

- Distributivity over Addition:

$$
A⊙(B+C)=A⊙B+A⊙C
$$

- Scalar Distributivity:

$$
\alpha (A⊙B)=(\alpha A)⊙B=A⊙(\alpha B)
$$

In this case, by the commutativity of the Hadamard product, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}^{T}+B⊙A & ={C}^{T}+A⊙B \\  & ={[\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}]}^{T}+[\begin{aligned}5 & -2 \\ -3 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4 & 0 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}5 & -2 \\ -3 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}9 & -2 \\ -4 & 3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
